ينكفئ (form VII)
# يَنْكَفِئُ (yankafiʔu) /jan.ka.fi.ʔu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْكَفَأَ (inkafaʔa)
# يَنْكَفِئَ (yankafiʔa) /jan.ka.fi.ʔa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْكَفَأَ (inkafaʔa)
# يَنْكَفِئْ (yankafiʔ) /jan.ka.fiʔ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْكَفَأَ (inkafaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
